id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cc4: "I see... Understood. I'll manage on my own somehow. I hope it goes well... Horse-fully!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cd6: "Oh! You'll help? I've never met anyone as kind as you in all my born days, hoof to hoof!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce1: "The old man said he was going to polish the Pegasus statue at the top of this tower, but he never came back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d0d: "The old man said he was going to polish the Pegasus statue at the top of this tower, but he never came back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cee: "If you go to the top floor with the statue, I'm sure you'll see what's happening. Please check on the old man.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d1a: "If you go to the top floor with the statue, I'm sure you'll see what's happening. Please check on the old man.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cfc: "I'll wait here for the old man to return. Then, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d28: "I'll wait here for the old man to return. Then, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d3f: "Traveler, thank you for saving the old man!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d45: "When not just the old man but I nearly merged with the Pegasus, I was truly stable-ized... I mean, stunned! Horse puns!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d50: "It's modest, but I prepared a gift for you. Please take it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d58: "Now the Pegasus statue won't merge with just anyone, and will accept only its true self.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d65: "Until the Pegasus returns to its original form, we'll keep watch in this tower. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d77: "What? How come I can talk so much for a horse?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d7c: "Sorry, it's a secret. I won't say why I can talk! Horse sense! Hee hee.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d94: "Hmm... that evil power I felt while merged with the Pegasus, what was it...? Who tampered with the statue...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1da2: "Anyway, you saved me. Both the horse and I will never forget your kindness.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dad: "I love horses. This Pegasus Tower is a tower for horses, so I look after it like this.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dc1: "They say the Pegasus has lost its true self because of a bad guy.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dca: "What's a true self? Do I have one too? I'm a horse, so I don't know.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dd9: "Someday I want to soar through the sky like the Pegasus. That's why I eat lots of food.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1de3: "The old man said wings might grow from my back if I do. I can't wait for them to grow.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dfc: "A sacred place to look at yourself anew and think about how you'll live. Do you wish to change your way of life?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e19: "...I'd like to say that, but for a certain reason I cannot let you walk a new path now...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e24: "As you can see, Dharma Temple is in an unprecedented Bouncy Babe boom...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e2c: "Elderly people from around the world who want to become Bouncy Babes have all rushed to me at once!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e38: "I told them I can't change anyone into a Bouncy Babe, but they won't listen. At this rate, Dharma Temple is finished.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e45: "...Unless we persuade these elders, the temple can't fulfill its true duty. Traveler, please hear my request.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e56: "The late temple head said a class-change book somewhere can turn anyone into a Bouncy Babe...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e64: "If you find that class-change book, could you bring it to me?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e75: "What, you refuse? That's a problem... If these people riot, what will become of Dharma Temple...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e8c: "Oh, you'll do it! Thank you, traveler! Now, about where the class-change book is...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e99: "Speaking of Bouncy Babes, maidens! Is there a place in your world where maidens gather?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ed7: "Speaking of Bouncy Babes, maidens! Is there a place in your world where maidens gather?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ea3: "If there's a library or the like, a Bouncy Babe class-change book must be there! First, find a place where maidens gather.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ee0: "If there's a library or the like, a Bouncy Babe class-change book must be there! First, find a place where maidens gather.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb0: "I'm sorry it's so vague, but if you get that book, bring it to me. I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eee: "I'm sorry it's so vague, but if you get that book, bring it to me. I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ec9: "If there's a class-change book that makes Bouncy Babes, we can grant the elders' wish. Now, about where it is...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f01: "Oh, traveler, welcome back. So, did you find that class-change book?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f0c: "Never mind... it may not even exist. Perhaps we should give up cleanly.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f2e: "Oh! This is the class-change book, the Bouncy Babe White Paper...!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f34: "An intriguing title... I wonder what's written inside. Let me read it right away...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f46: "Sorry, I got excited. But with this book, anyone can become a Bouncy Babe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f50: "Now the elders' wish will be granted and Dharma Temple will revive. Here, this is my thanks.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f5e: "This world is overrun with monsters and in utter chaos...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f8a: "This world is overrun with monsters and in utter chaos...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f65: "Dharma Temple's true duty is to show a new path to the young people who destroy those monsters.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f91: "Dharma Temple's true duty is to show a new path to the young people who destroy those monsters.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f73: "Thanks to you, we can carry out that duty. I'll never forget this favor. Thank you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f9e: "Thanks to you, we can carry out that duty. I'll never forget this favor. Thank you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa9: "...Still, everyone wanting to be a Bouncy Babe has caused quite a mess.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fb0: "Maybe we should make Bouncy Babe an official class. Ho ho ho!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fc8: "This is Dharma Temple. A sacred place that has governed people's paths in life since ancient times.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd2: "That said, we're swamped now. Please ask the temple head for details.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fe2: "This is Dharma Temple. A sacred place that has governed people's paths in life since ancient times...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fec: "Or so it should be. Now it's become this lively, and I'm confused too.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2012: "I'll become a Bouncy Babe... I'll become a Bouncy Babe...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2022: "N-next is me! At last I'll become a Bouncy Babe!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2031: "Once more, to make my life bloom, I'll become a Bouncy Babe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|203a: "Then I might give you a puff-puff.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204c: "Then I might give you a puff-puff.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|205b: "Then I might give you a puff-puff.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2043: "I'll become a Bouncy Babe and toy with men all over the world. I'll become that kind of gal.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2055: "Mmph, I can't stand it. I want to be a Bouncy Babe soon.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2067: "Almost there... I'm about to become a Bouncy Babe!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2070: "Not yet...? When will I become a Bouncy Babe!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|207a: "I can become a Bouncy Babe, my long-held dream. I could die happy now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2083: "Oh, no no! I can only die after I become a Bouncy Babe and shed tears of joy!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2093: "You think I want to be a Bouncy Babe too, don't you? Heh heh... What I want to be is a secret!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20a4: "Bouncy Babe has been my dream since childhood.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20aa: "If you're a man, you'll understand. Wanting to be a Bouncy Babe is a man's eternal dream.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ba: "What? Why do we want to be Bouncy Babes? ...Heh, a foolish question.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20c1: "If there's a mountain, you climb it, don't you? If there's a sea, you swim it, don't you? It's the same, young one.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20d1: "Come on, not yet?! Hurry and make us Bouncy Babes! Mumble mumble...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20da: "That temple head... he clearly has no intention of making me a Bouncy Babe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ea: "I want to be a Bouncy Babe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20f0: "Can't I be a Bouncy Babe yet?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20f9: "Whoooa!! At long last I've become a Bouncy Babe!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ff: "I wish I could show my late wife this form. Sob, sob...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2115: "Hee hee... Don't just work so seriously. Shall I give you a puff-puff?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2120: "That's right. What I wanted to be wasn't a Bouncy Babe but a merchant! See, my clothes are bouncy, aren't they?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2134: "Oh... my precious Mystic flute. Without that flute, I can no longer meet Lord Psaro...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|213d: "Controlling Psaro Knight to attack us... who would do something so cruel...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2150: "...Thank you, traveler. Now I can meet Lord Psaro again.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2159: "Oh... I'm so happy. Somehow... tears... sob...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2164: But the Ruby tears⏎crumbled without a sound...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2178: "Ugh... what was I doing... Thanks to you I've regained my senses. How can I thank you...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2185: "A terrible voice echoed in my head. Destroy... destroy everything... After that, I remember nothing.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2191: "Even if it wasn't my will, I, in this room to protect Rosaly, turned my sword on her...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|219f: "And I broke the precious Mystic flute connecting Rosaly and Lord Psaro...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21a8: "I'm unfit as a gatekeeper... Should I pack my things and leave this tower...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b7: "What! You say a new Mystic flute can be made! Thank you, nameless traveler!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21c4: "My heart's burden is lifted. From now on I'll fulfill my duty as Rosaly's gatekeeper properly.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21e5: "Wobble, wobble... Thank you for helping us. You're a very kind traveler.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ee: "But don't scold Psaro Knight. He's Rosaly's gatekeeper, not a bad monster.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21fa: "I don't know why, but he suddenly changed, shouting 'My lord's orders!' and chased us around.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2208: "...And then Psaro Knight broke the Mystic flute Rosaly treasured.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2210: "Without that flute, Rosaly's lover Lord Psaro can't enter this room, so Psaro Knight feels responsible.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|221e: "Rosaly would be sad too if she couldn't meet her beloved Lord Psaro. He's her precious lover...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|222a: "So I want to make a new Mystic flute and give it to Rosaly! Traveler, could you help?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|223e: "...Wobble. I see. You're busy, traveler. Sorry for asking too much.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2252: "Wobble! Thank you! I'd like you to gather materials for the Mystic flute.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|225d: "My grandmother says the branch used for the Mystic flute has to be a special one.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2269: "She said an enchanted branch that grows only in the forest where fairies live is just right.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2275: "If you get an enchanted branch, bring it to me! Then I can make the Mystic flute!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2282: "Don't worry about Rosaly and Psaro Knight! I'll stay right by them!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2294: "I want Rosaly and Psaro Knight to feel better, so I really want to make a new Mystic flute!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|229f: "If you get the enchanted branch that grows in the fairy forest, bring it to me! Then I can make the Mystic flute!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22ae: "Don't worry about Rosaly and Psaro Knight! I'll stay right by them!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22be: "Wobble. Welcome back, traveler. Did you get the enchanted branch?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22c7: Give the mystic branch⏎to the Slime?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22ce: "...I see. But I'll wait. I want to see Rosaly's happy face. So please bring the enchanted branch.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22e7: "...Wobble! A-amazing! I can feel the magic overflowing from this branch! Thank you, traveler!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22f1: "Now I can make a new Mystic flute! I think Rosaly and Psaro Knight will be so happy!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22fc: "It's small, but this is my thanks. Take it! Wobble!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|230b: "Knowing the Mystic flute can be made, Rosaly and Psaro Knight have both perked up a lot.
